title: Close a storage drawer over a bulky pillow
instruction: The pillow in the open drawer stands higher than the drawer's opening. Shut the drawer completely with the whole pillow inside: hold the pillow down while you push the drawer in, and get your hand out as it closes. Then let go and move both arms away from the drawer.
context: A bulky pillow catches on a storage drawer’s frame when the drawer is pushed shut. Closing it requires keeping the raised parts compressed as they pass under the frame.
setup: Units mm. x forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the robot's left, z up from the table top. Two YAM arms with parallel grippers (pads 94 apart when open), bases at (0, +305) and (0, -305), at their ready pose with grippers open; one overhead camera and one camera on each wrist. Table top 1100 x 1300. Nothing else is on the table. (1) Storage drawer, true size: Sterilite 16 Qt. Stacking Drawer, model 2301, white frame and clear drawer, 432 front to back x 365 wide x 175 high outside; the drawer is 416 x 302 x 124 deep inside (maker's figures). The frame stands with its front face at x = 390, centred on y = 0, its opening facing the robot, clamped to the table with its back against a stop. The drawer slides straight in and out (about 3 N to move it, no spring, no soft-close, a stop at 300) and starts pulled out 220, its front at x = 170. The top of the drawer's sides is 146 above the table and the underside of the frame's top, which the pillow catches on, 152 (estimates, to be measured on the unit). (2) Pillow, true size: Therm-a-Rest Compressible Pillow Cinch, Regular, 460 x 330 x 150 thick lying free, 325 g, foam filling in a polyester cover (retailer's figures). It lies in the drawer, squeezed to the drawer's 416 x 302 plan, long side front to back. Its top is 172 above the table over the middle 205 of its length, 20 above the opening; 162 for about 50 either side of that; and below the opening for the last 50 or so at each end. With the drawer out 220, the rear 205 of the pillow is already under the frame's top and about 210 is in the open: of that, counting from the frame, about 100 stand 20 above the opening, 50 stand 10 above it and the 50 nearest the drawer front are below it. Firmness, set with the pillow's cinch cord: a 1.5 kg book laid flat on the middle presses the top down to about the drawer's rim (estimate). The layout is the same in every trial.
scoring: Judged at the end of the trial from a photo from the front, a ruler and the trial video. Open: the gap between the frame's front face and the drawer front. Pillow in the drawer: the whole pillow lies inside the drawer's walls on its floor. Shut: open 5 mm or less, the pillow in the drawer and no part of the pillow showing outside the frame. Hands clear: no part of the robot touches the unit or the pillow and each gripper's centre point is at least 50 mm from the frame, the drawer and its pull. Score 0 if the pillow is not in the drawer, or if the frame has been shifted more than 10 mm on the table. Otherwise the highest of: 1.0 if the drawer is shut and the hands have been clear for 2 s; 0.75 if the drawer is shut; 0.5 if it is open 90 mm or less; 0.25 if it is open 190 mm or less; otherwise 0. The pillow's three bulging parts catch on the frame at 214, 163 and 112 mm, so 0.25 means the first is under the frame's top and 0.5 means all three are. Only the state at the end counts: a drawer shut and then pulled open again scores by where it ends. The trial ends at the run limit, or as soon as 1.0 is reached.
reset_notes: Pull the drawer out to 220 mm (a tape mark on the table under its front). Take the pillow out, shake it back to its full thickness, lay it in the drawer long side front to back and tuck its corners inside the walls. Check the frame is against its stop and clamped. Arms at their ready pose, grippers open. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: PhysX at 240 Hz, 20 Hz control. Fixed frame; rigid drawer with 3 N force-capped damping. Pillow: loose base plus 16 rigid pads on vertical springs (60 N/m, 6 N s/m), drawn as one non-colliding fabric surface. A partly covered pad is held down as a whole; local bulging, wrinkles and snagging are absent. Model walls are 8 mm thick. Pillow profile, stiffness, internal heights and friction are estimates; no hardware trial. Full details: REFERENCE-SPEC.json and TECHNICAL.md.
